implementation_strategy: Execute preregistered confirmatory paired run (scenario_recommended_200) via hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter: deterministic challenging_workflow_stress_v1 indices fixed a priori (list above), one shared initial generation call per task, and up to one guarded repair call per task. All scoring and validation performed by deterministic automated scorers provided by the adapter; runtime provider parameters, timestamps, HTTP codes, and raw artifacts recorded in the execution manifest. Primary analysis uses complete pairs only; sensitivity analysis treats missing guarded episodes as failures (0).
task_manifest_strategy: Use adapter-prescribed deterministic challenging_workflow_stress_v1 index rule to select 200 task indices (five offsets per eight-task cycle; cycles 0..39). Archive full telemetry for first 20 task_indices.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 (one generation call). Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 (initial generation + at most one repair call if deterministic validators fail). Apply automatic_rejection_rules and semantic-equivalence checks as preregistered.
execution_batches: single batch: process the 200 deterministic task_indices in ascending order; record per-task timestamps and provider metadata
randomisation_plan: No randomisation; deterministic adapter-prescribed selection. Record runtime sampling parameters in execution manifest.
caching_plan: Do not reuse cached model outputs across tasks; store all raw outputs and SHA-256 hashes for reproducibility.
failure_recovery_plan: No manual retries beyond adapter limits (maximum_attempts_per_call=1). Infrastructure/provider errors logged and counted per missingness_plan; primary analysis uses complete pairs only; sensitivity treats missing guarded episodes as failures (0).
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (version 1.0): per-episode fields include task_index, condition, raw_model_output, deterministic_validator_trace, binary_success_label, detection_latency_ms, model_call_metadata, output_sha256.
estimated_compute_notes: Model-call budget arithmetic: 200 tasks × 1 initial generation = 200 calls; up to 200 guarded repairs = 200 calls → maximum 400 calls. Set estimated_model_calls=400 and maximum_model_calls=400 to match adapter contract and preregistration.
